title: DeepSeek Is Raising V4 Flash Prices by Up to 4X
kw_reason: The whole short is about DeepSeek's price going up because of V4 Flash demand, and how cheap it stays after the increase; prices is the word the news turns on.
hl_reason: The cover states the news in one line of thought: DeepSeek is raising prices. The 2X to 4X size and the still-cheap caveat live in the title and descriptions, and the short highlight keeps the terracotta line the biggest type.
claim: Demand for DeepSeek V4 Flash is forcing DeepSeek to raise its prices two to four times in the coming weeks, yet it stays one of the best models per token and per task, and businesses can also run it locally on their own machines.
quotes: they have to significantly increase their prices in the few coming weeks
even if they increase their prices by two to four X, this is still one of the best models that you can use in terms of price per token and price per task

reason: A timely pricing change for DeepSeek V4 Flash with why it matters (still cheap per token and per task) and one practical alternative (run it locally); no repeatable procedure is taught.
yd:
DeepSeek V4 Flash is so popular that DeepSeek has to significantly raise its prices in the coming weeks. Even at two to four times the current price, it stays one of the best models you can use in terms of price per token and price per task. And if you are a business, you can also buy your own machines and run it locally as your own AI employee.
